data.exact_reserve_text: The prior accident year experience has been less benign. Deterioration on the earned and booked position on some accounts has had a negative impact on the Syndicate's result for the year. In particular, deterioration on certain Marine Insurance segments has dragged back the performance of this class. The legacy Solicitor's Professional Indemnity portfolio, from which the Syndicate has now exited, also exhibited some deterioration in the first half of the calendar year based on claims development on prior years' exposures. Recent development has been more stable but reserves have nonetheless been strengthened.

data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2015 the Syndicate's gross claims outstanding were GBP 418.878m. Analysis of the claims development triangle shows net adverse prior year development of approximately GBP 11.8m (gross), largely driven by movements on the 2012 and 2013 underwriting years, representing ~2.8% of opening gross reserves. Narrative in the report identifies deterioration in prior accident years (notably in certain Marine segments and a legacy Solicitor's PI portfolio) as drivers of the strengthening, while the 2013 Year of Account was reinsured-to-close into 2014 producing a recognised profit of GBP 6.3m.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development was calculated from the gross claims development table (claims triangle) on page 46 by comparing the current estimate to the prior diagonal for UW years 2012 and 2013 (excluding the aggregate '2011 & prior' column). The report does not present a separate explicit 'movement in prior year's provision' gross line; narrative references are net or qualitative. The triangle may be affected by reinsurance-to-close and SPS cessions, and the 2013 RITC and SPS movements are noted in the report and may distort direct comparisons. Confidence in the computed gross PYD is 0.8 (calculated from stated values).
